runs.content: Johnson & Johnson was bought on its Q3 beat-and-raise (adj. EPS $2.59 vs $2.53, FY26 guidance raised on Tremfya +68% and Darzalex +15%) while flat over 3 months at ~23x forward; ISTR was exited as a capacity trim at $28.04 (−4.37%, −$44), and portfolio net P&L is +$2,371 (+2.86% on $83,000).

Consumer staples led a defensive rotation out of AI and semiconductors on 10-22, and P&G's FY27 Q1 delivered volume-led +4% organic growth across all categories with guidance maintained, at ~22x forward earnings.
